products.name: Headroom
products.tagline: Slash Claude Code and Codex token usage with local compression, project learnings, and add-ons
products.review_summary: Customers appreciate Headroom, praising its impressive token savings and seamless local compression. Many users report significant reductions in token usage, allowing for longer coding sessions without hitting limits. There are minor drawbacks, such as initial setup challenges and some interface clunkiness, but these are being actively addressed with regular updates. Overall, Headroom is a hit, making it a smart choice for anyone looking to optimize their AI coding experience. With a one-person license covering multiple computers and a focus on continuous improvement, it's worth giving it a try!

products.name: MiroMiro
products.tagline: Inspect any element, extract the full design system, and export clean Tailwind or HTML from any site
products.review_summary: Customers appreciate MiroMiro, praising its ability to effortlessly extract design systems, export clean HTML, and save significant time during web design processes. Users also highlight the intuitive interface and responsive support team as major benefits. There are minor drawbacks, such as compatibility issues with certain browsers, but MiroMiro now supports Arc, Comet, and Opera in addition to Chrome, Edge, Brave, and Firefox. Overall, MiroMiro is a standout choice for designers, and with a 60-day money-back guarantee, it's a no-brainer to give it a try for just $49!

products.name: Notte
products.tagline: Build browser automation scripts, AI agents, and serverless API endpoints from a single platform
products.review_summary: Customers appreciate Notte, praising its powerful automation capabilities, the flexibility of the Anything API, and the clean user interface that simplifies complex tasks. While some users mention a steep learning curve, these are minor bumps in an otherwise solid experience. Overall, Notte is making waves in the automation space, and with a 60-day money-back guarantee, it's a risk-free opportunity to enhance your browser workflows. Don't miss out on this gem, with pricing starting at $69 for Tier 1, and additional tiers available for those needing more resources.

products.name: Vibe App Scanner
products.tagline: Scan AI-built and vibe-coded apps for security vulnerabilities—ranked findings, copy-paste fixes
products.review_summary: Customers appreciate Vibe App Scanner for its ability to identify security vulnerabilities, provide actionable fixes, and deliver comprehensive findings that enhance the development process. Users also commend the founders for their active engagement with feedback and willingness to improve the tool. Minor drawbacks include the variability in coverage depending on language and framework, and some findings may not be fully complete. Overall, Vibe App Scanner is a valuable tool for applications built with modern coding tools, making it a solid buy at $49, especially with a 60-day money-back guarantee. Give it a try!

products.name: MarkupGo
products.tagline: Automate your image and PDF conversions with a single, powerful API
products.review_summary: Customers value MarkupGo for its seamless API integration, high-quality image and PDF generation, and responsive customer support. Some users have mentioned minor limitations such as the absence of direct PDF editing and occasional performance issues. With an overall rating of 4.8 and positive feedback, MarkupGo is a reliable choice for those seeking automated image and PDF conversions. With a 60-day money-back guarantee, it's definitely worth trying out.

products.name: Reoon Lead Scraper (YellowPages)
products.tagline: Scraping data from Yellow Pages has never been this simple
products.review_summary: The review summary should be: "Customers are all about Reoon YellowPages Scraper, praising its ease of use, fast results, and cost-effectiveness. The cherry on top, it offers a lifetime license with updates and a free trial for testing. There are a few hiccups like occasional data duplication and the need for proxies in some cases, just small bumps on the road. Weighing the raves against the occasional grumbles, Reoon YellowPages Scraper is hitting the mark and is a solid buy for those in need of a reliable lead generation tool. Given the lifetime license and the free trial option, it's worth a try."

products.name: Local Scraper - Lead Generation Software
products.tagline: The original 7-in-1 lead generation software that lets you scrape the largest maps sites for leads.
products.review_summary: Local Scraper - Lead Generation Software is highly regarded for its versatility in scraping data from multiple sources, user-friendly interface, and prompt customer support. While some users have reported occasional crashes and incorrect data, the overall positive feedback and 4.4 rating make it a solid buy, especially with the added benefit of a 60-day money-back guarantee.

products.name: DivMagic
products.tagline: Copy design from any website, copy code of any web element with one click, and even convert formats
products.best_for: Developers, Web design agencies, Web designers
products.review_summary: Customers appreciate DivMagic for its seamless design copying, one-click code extraction, and format conversion. While some users faced minor issues with accuracy and speed, the overall consensus is positive. With an impressive 4.4 rating from 41 reviews, DivMagic is a solid buy, especially with its lifetime access to the extension and all future updates. Give it a try and experience the time-saving benefits firsthand!

products.name: Twidget.io
products.tagline: Build Web Applications and APIs visually and streamline your development process
products.review_summary: Customers have been praising Twidget.io for its intuitive interface, powerful API creation, and responsive support. While there are some concerns about limited documentation and a learning curve, these are minor issues. Overall, Twidget.io is a solid choice for those in need of a visual web application and API development tool. With an overall rating of 4.9 and a 60-day money-back guarantee, it's definitely worth giving it a try!

products.name: PeekShot
products.tagline: Screenshot automation for teams. Schedule, bulk capture, and get clean hosted screenshots at scale.
products.review_summary: Customers appreciate PeekShot, praising its simplicity, effective integration into workflows, and the ability to capture high-quality screenshots effortlessly. While some users noted minor issues with Cloudflare blocking requests, the platform has made significant improvements to its core rendering engine for better reliability and cleaner captures. The initial lack of support for WebP and AVIF formats has not been mentioned in recent updates, indicating a focus on enhancing the tool's capabilities. Overall, PeekShot is a standout tool for teams needing reliable screenshot automation. With a 60-day money-back guarantee, it's a risk-free opportunity to enhance your screenshot game—definitely worth a try!

products.name: NativeRest
products.tagline: Create, debug and test your API with a fast and lightweight API-client for Windows, macOS and Linux
products.review_summary: 'Customers appreciate NativeRest for its speed, lightweight interface, and offline capabilities. Users love the seamless API testing experience, responsive developer support, and the ability to work across multiple platforms. Some users have noted minor issues with synchronization speed and missing features like YAML code snippet generation. However, with an overall rating of 4.9 and a 60-day money-back guarantee, NativeRest is a solid buy for anyone in need of a fast and efficient API client. Give it a try and experience the difference!'
